name: loader-inscribe
title: Inscribe loader
description: The word youj draws itself in outline, letter by letter, on a type designer’s guide lines; the tittle lands in the accent, then the strokes lift off the way they went down. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.
